title: Artisan Trigger
description: A Trigger runs an action chain when a game event happens. File `triggers/<id>.yml`; the id is the file name.

on.description: A declared game event: a core one (`player_death`) or a module's (`quests:completed`). A name the server does not declare is reported on load and never fires.

if.description: Conditions, all required, checked with the event bound as `event`. If one fails the Trigger does not run and its cooldown does not start.

cooldown_seconds.description: Per-player delay between two runs. Stored in the database: it survives restarts and follows the player across the network.

enabled.description: false: the Trigger loads but never runs.

notes.description: The author's notes, never read by the server.

do.description: The chain run during the event, with the event bound as `event` (`{event.location.x}`). `cancel_event` and `set_event` act on the current event.
